edges.reason: uniswapV2Router is the external swap target used by swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router receives the addLiquidityETH call.
Router factory is used in the constructor to create the pair.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to classify buys and sells.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned by autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned by manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
swapping flag gates fee and swap logic inside _transfer.
maxTransactionAmount is enforced on buys and sells.
swapTokensAtAmount determines whether swapBack is triggered.
maxWallet is enforced on the recipient balance.
percentForLPBurn scales the automatic burn amount.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn call.
lpBurnFrequency is added to lastLpBurnTime for the burn timer.
lastLpBurnTime is compared with block.timestamp in _transfer.
manualBurnFrequency defines the manual burn cooldown.
lastManualLpBurnTime is checked and updated in the manual burn.
limitsInEffect gates the limit enforcement block.
tradingActive restricts transfers before launch.
swapEnabled must be true for swapBack to run.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written using tx.origin.
transferDelayEnabled gates the anti-bot per-block check.
buyTotalFees is used to compute the buy fee.
sellTotalFees is used to compute the sell fee.
tokensForMarketing accumulates the marketing fee share.
tokensForLiquidity accumulates the liquidity fee share.
tokensForDev accumulates the dev fee share.
_isExcludedFromFees controls fee exemption and swap eligibility.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount bypasses limit checks.
automatedMarketMakerPairs classifies transfers as buys or sells.
marketingWallet is the target of the residual balance low-level call.
devWallet is the target of the dev ETH low-level call.
Constructor registers the newly created pair via _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router and pair.
_transfer calls swapBack, which forwards ETH with low-level calls while user balances are updated in the same transaction.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, which performs an external pair.sync() call.
swapBack delegates the token-to-ETH swap to swapTokensForEth.
swapBack delegates liquidity provision to addLiquidity.
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level value call to devWallet, a potential reentrancy entry point.
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level value call to marketingWallet with the full contract balance.
swapTokensForEth routes the swap through the external Uniswap router.
addLiquidity forwards ETH to the external Uniswap router via addLiquidityETH.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the external pair contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the external pair contract.
tx.origin is used as the anti-bot per-block delay key, so a malicious intermediary contract can spoof the origin semantics.
block.timestamp is compared with lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger the LP burn.
enableTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp.
The manual burn cooldown depends on block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the deployer msg.sender.
msg.sender is resolved as the sender in ERC20 transfer and approve flows.
